summary: Tool timeouts can leave AI agents facing ambiguous tool outcomes and partial execution: an action may have failed, committed or remained in flight while other workflow steps have already completed. We formulate evidence-guided task recovery over approved obligations, provider capabilities and states compatible with public evidence.
takeaways: A preregistered assignment-held-out comparison then evaluates planning advice against evidence prompting with two local model bundles.
The known-model implementation combines standard observation-contingent planning with a separately implemented effect-history adjudicator.
In a finite study of 37 assignments, planning and three active controls each certify 28 completions; four saved synthetic fee units incur additional computation.
